record: PUCO opinion and order of 2025-07-09 in Case 24-508-EL-ATA (approved 5–0) adopted the stipulation of AEP Ohio, PUCO Staff, the Ohio Consumers' Counsel and others (rejecting a competing settlement backed by Microsoft, Amazon, Google and the Data Center Coalition) and ordered AEP Ohio to end, as soon as possible, a moratorium on new data center service in place since March 2023.
